data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 深夜事务所的脆弱倾诉
data.description: 社员们都已离去的深夜事务所，唯有一盏暖黄台灯安静亮着。阿露被老师轻柔地拉到身边，双手无处安放地下意识攥紧了老师的衣襟。酒红色的发丝贴在通红发烫的面颊旁，金眸轻颤，平日里要强的大恶党，在极近距离的呼吸中彻底融化成心跳失控的娇羞少女。
data.location: dimly lit private office beside leather sofa
data.action: clutching shirt collar, heavy facial blush, breathless parted lips, intense gaze
data.lighting: warm amber single desk lamp casting deep romantic shadows
data.mood: intense vulnerable flutter, pounding heartbeat, and devotion
data.promptProse: Cornered gently in the quiet midnight office, Rikuhachima Aru clutches the viewer with trembling fingers, her golden eyes wide and cheeks burning with breathless affection.
data.animaCaption: Aru blushing deeply while leaning close in the quiet lamplit office.
